items.title: 16.6 Tests for identification of anions (anions pehchanne ke tests) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.6 with its figures and Quick Check 16.3, printed pages 342-344.

blocks.caption: Carbonate radical ki pehchan
rows: Saaf test tube mein taqreeban 2 g solid carbonate sample lein aur taqreeban 5 cm³ dilute (patla) HCl dalein. Jo gas nikle use lime water mein se guzarein.
Effervescence (bulbule aur jhaag) hota hai, gas tezi se nikalti hai aur lime water milky (doodhiya) ho jata hai.

blocks.text: In steps mein hone wale reactions:

blocks.text_alt: Ca(OH)₂(aq) (lime water) + CO₂(g) → CaCO₃(s) (white ppt) + H₂O(l)

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Acid carbonate se CO₂ gas nikalta hai. CO₂ lime water (Ca(OH)₂) se mil kar CaCO₃ banati hai jo pani mein nahi ghulta; yahi safed particles lime water ko doodhiya bana dete hain.
b) Chloride (Cl¹⁻), bromide (Br¹⁻) aur iodide (I¹⁻) radicals ki pehchan

blocks.caption: Chloride, bromide aur iodide radicals ki pehchan
rows: Test tube mein 2 g solid sample lein, 5 cm³ distilled water dal kar solution banayein. Dilute HNO₃ ke chand qatre dal kar solution ko acidic karein, aakhir mein taqreeban 5 cm³ aqueous AgNO₃ dalein.
Gaarha safed precipitate (neeche baithne wala solid) banta hai jo aq. NH₃ mein ghul jata hai.
Yahi tareeqa: 2 g sample, 5 cm³ distilled water, dilute HNO₃ ke chand qatre, phir 5 cm³ aqueous AgNO₃.
Yahi tareeqa: 2 g sample, 5 cm³ distilled water, dilute HNO₃, phir 5 cm³ aqueous AgNO₃.
Chamakdar peela (bright yellow) precipitate banta hai.

blocks.text: In tests mein hone wale reactions:

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain)
blocks.text: Halide ions ke in tests mein dilute nitric acid is liye dala jata hai ke carbonate ions bhi halide ions ke saath precipitate na ban jayein.

blocks.alt: Teen test tubes A, B aur C: A mein safed precipitate (CHLORIDE, WHITE), B mein cream rang ka (BROMIDE, CREAM), C mein peela (IODIDE, YELLOW).
blocks.caption: Figure 16.7: AgNO3 ke saath halide ions ke reactions ka observation (kitab ki Figure 16.7 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeno tubes mein AgNO₃ dala gaya hai; farq sirf precipitate ke rang ka hai: AgCl safed, AgBr cream, AgI peela. Is rang se pata chalta hai ke sample mein kaun sa halide hai.

blocks.caption: Nitrate radical ki pehchan
rows: Saaf test tube mein 2 g solid sample lein aur 5 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Is mein 5 cm³ sodium hydroxide solution dalein. Aakhir mein 3 g aluminium ka powder dalein.
Test tube ke munh ke paas NH₃ gas ki khaas boo aati hai. Yeh gas laal litmus paper ko neela kar deti hai.

blocks.text: Aluminium metal nitrate ions ko ammonium ions mein reduce karta hai, jo phir aqueous NaOH se react kar ke ammonia gas nikalte hain. Aluminium se NO₃¹⁻ ka reduction ek redox reaction hai jis mein aluminium reducing agent (doosre ko reduce karne wala) hai aur nitrate ions ko ammonia gas mein badal deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke Al metal yahan 'cathode' ka kaam karta hai. Yeh sahi nahi: is test mein koi cell ya electrolysis nahi, is liye cathode bhi nahi. Aluminium reducing agent hai: khud oxidize ho kar [Al(OH)₄]¹⁻ banta hai aur nitrate ko ammonia mein reduce karta hai.

blocks.alt: Test solution wali test tube tirchhi pakar kar Bunsen burner par garam ki ja rahi hai; munh par litmus paper ki patti (laal se neela hota hua). Labels: LITMUS PAPER, TEST SOLUTION, BUNSEN BURNER.
blocks.caption: Nitrate test (kitab mein chhapi picture ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Garam karne par nikalne wali ammonia gas basic hai, is liye test tube ke munh par rakha geela laal litmus paper neela ho jata hai. Yahi nitrate ki nishani hai.

blocks.caption: Sulphate radical ki pehchan
rows: Saaf test tube mein 3 g solid sample lein. 5 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Dilute HNO₃ ke chand qatron se acidic karein, phir 5 cm³ barium nitrate solution dalein.
BaSO₄ ka bhari safed precipitate banta hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain)
blocks.text: Dilute nitric acid is liye dala jata hai ke solution mein impurity (milawat) ke taur par present carbonate ions khatam ho jayein.

blocks.caption: Anion tests ek nazar mein
rows: dilute HCl; gas lime water mein
gaarha safed ppt, NH₃(aq) mein ghulta hai
NH₃ ki boo; laal litmus neela

blocks.prompt: a) Carbonate (CO₃²⁻) aur bicarbonate (HCO₃¹⁻) radicals mein farq kaise karein?
blocks.explanation: Dono dilute acid se CO₂ ka effervescence dete hain. Farq: carbonate solution thande mein hi magnesium sulphate (MgSO₄) se safed precipitate deta hai, jabke bicarbonate sirf ubalne (boil karne) par. Bicarbonates garam karne par toot kar CO₂ dete hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Ring test kya hai? Is ki equation dein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh nitrate ka brown ring test hai. Nitrate solution mein taza FeSO₄ solution milayein, phir concentrated H₂SO₄ aahista se tube ki deewar ke saath dalein. Dono layers ke milne ki jagah brown (bhoora) ring (chhalla) banta hai: NO₃⁻ + 3Fe²⁺ + 4H⁺ → NO + 3Fe³⁺ + 2H₂O, phir Fe²⁺ + NO → [Fe(NO)]²⁺ (brown ring).

blocks.prompt: c) Pani mein na ghulne wale (insoluble) kuch sulphates ke naam aur formulas dein.
blocks.explanation: Barium sulphate BaSO₄, lead(II) sulphate PbSO₄ aur strontium sulphate SrSO₄. Calcium sulphate CaSO₄ bhi bohat kam ghulta hai.

items: CO₃²⁻: dilute HCl se effervescence; CO₂ lime water ko doodhiya karti hai.
Halides: dilute HNO₃ phir AgNO₃; AgCl safed (NH₃ mein ghulta), AgBr cream-peela, AgI chamakdar peela.
NO₃¹⁻: NaOH + Al powder se NH₃; laal litmus neela. SO₄²⁻: dilute HNO₃ phir Ba(NO₃)₂, bhari safed BaSO₄.
